Errata: Johnny Silverhand: Never Stop Fighting (Beta Iconic Rare)
Welcome to Night City Card Errata
The Beta Iconic Rare variant of *Johnny Silverhand: Never Stop Fighting* was erroneously printed with the Eurodollar “Sell” tag. Consistent with all other versions of *Johnny Silverhand: Never Stop Fighting*, this card cannot be sold for an Eddie during gameplay.
This errata supersedes the card's printed text at all levels of play.

Errata: Kiroshi Optics
Welcome to Night City Card Errata
The reminder text about how equipping Gear works on *Kiroshi Optics* is inconsistent with other Gear cards in *Cyberpunk TCG*. The reminder text has been updated to “Equip to a friendly Unit or face-up Legend”, in line with all other Gear cards.
This errata supersedes the card's printed text at all levels of play.

Errata: Nocturne OP55N1
Welcome to Night City Card Errata
*Nocturne OP55N1* was printed with an incorrect artist credit. The card text has been revised to properly credit the creator of this art piece — Daniel Valaisis.
This errata supersedes the card's printed text at all levels of play.

Errata: Judy Álvarez: Nothing to Doubt
Welcome to Night City Card Errata
The printed artist credit on *Judy Álvarez: Nothing to Doubt* contains a typo. It has been corrected to properly credit the artist — Ilya Kuvshinov.
This errata supersedes the card's printed text at all levels of play.
